_about: Tunehold design tokens, palette A (Dusk). Structure copied from the replica-design template: role names stay, values are Tunehold's own. "color" is the app (dark first); "color-light" is the landing page and uses the same role names, so the same "pairs" list applies to both blocks. contrast.py reads only "color"; check the light block by copying it into "color" in a temporary file (see replica/brand.md, Palette). Font: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono (Braille Institute; SIL Open Font License 1.1; Google Fonts), replacing the template's Inter. Check every change with: python3 .claude/skills/replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

_roles.surface-raised: menus, dialogs, sheets, hovered and selected rows
_roles.border: dividers only (decorative, below 3:1 on purpose; never the only edge of a control)
_roles.border-input: outlines of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 or more on every background)
_roles.text-muted: artist, album, durations, metadata, helper text
_roles.accent: primary buttons, links, active tab, progress fill, focus ring
_roles.on-accent: text and icons on an accent, accent-2 or danger fill
_roles.accent-2: small highlights: now-playing marker, 'new' badge, selection marker; never a large fill
_roles.danger: delete, failed uploads, end plan (text, icon or button fill with on-accent text)
_roles.success: 'added' ticks and short status text only; never a button or a large fill

font.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
font.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
